query: What storage solutions are recommended for AI data centers, and which Chinese vendors are notable?
response:
For AI data centers, storage solutions must address extreme demands: high bandwidth (for GPU/TPU training), massive parallel I/O, low latency, scalability to exabytes, resilience for long-running jobs, and cost-efficiency for both hot (active training) and cold (archival/model zoo) data. Here's a breakdown of recommended architectures and notable Chinese vendors:

---

### ✅ **Recommended Storage Solutions for AI Data Centers**

| Category | Technology | Key Requirements | Why It Fits AI Workloads |
|----------|------------|------------------|---------------------------|
| **High-Performance Parallel File Systems** | Lustre, WekaFS, VAST Data, DDN EXAScaler, WekaIO | ≥100 GB/s aggregate bandwidth, sub-100μs metadata latency, POSIX compliance | Enables concurrent access by thousands of GPUs; supports large file I/O (e.g., 100GB+ model checkpoints, dataset shards) with minimal contention. |
| **Object Storage (with High-Throughput Acceleration)** | S3-compatible systems (e.g., Ceph with NVMe caching, MinIO + NVMe tier, Cloudian) + intelligent tiering & RDMA support | Scalable to EB+, S3 API, built-in erasure coding, integrated cache tiers (NVMe/DRAM) | Ideal for petabyte-scale datasets (e.g., LAION, Common Crawl); cost-effective archival + fast retrieval via intelligent caching and RDMA-accelerated object access. |
| **AI-Native/Unified Storage Platforms** | Pure Storage FlashBlade//EB, NetApp AFF/Astra, Dell PowerScale (with AI analytics plugins) | Unified file/object/NFS/S3, AI-aware QoS, built-in data versioning (e.g., DVC integration), ML-driven predictive caching | Simplifies data pipeline ops; enables reproducible experiments, snapshot-based version control, and workload-aware resource allocation. |
| **In-Memory / Ultra-Low-Latency Tier** | Redis, Alluxio (as distributed cache layer), or persistent memory (Intel Optane/CXL-attached PMem) | <10μs read latency, high throughput for metadata & small files (e.g., image labels, config files) | Accelerates metadata-heavy workloads (e.g., PyTorch DataLoader shuffling, feature lookup) — often deployed as a transparent cache in front of Lustre or object stores. |
| **Cold/Archival Tier** | Tape libraries (LTFS), optical jukeboxes, or deep-tier object storage (e.g., Alibaba Cloud OSS Infrequent Access + Archive) | $/TB < $0.005, WORM compliance, 10+ yr retention | For frozen models, raw datasets, audit logs — balances durability, compliance, and TCO. |
